author: GoldenApplGamer
body: My minecraft username is GoldenApplGamer and I was banned about a year ago(my name was JAMESANDTRAVIS back then). I was Afk but my game was glitching/lagging a bit before i left. When i got back i was banned for flying and i think the block underneath me disappeared leaving me floating. I can see how this was mistaken as hacking but rescently I've been wanting to go on Avicus and, well, I can't. Please Un-Ban me, i'm a 12 year old and I hate hackers and I love this server. I think a year has been long enough and this is my first apeal(on any server).

title: Please un-ban me!

replies.author: Porkyyy
replies.body:
Hello,

Due to the amount of time you have served as a banned user, and since we have no evidence of you hacking, I am going to appeal you.
Welcome back!

Regards,
MLGPorky, Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
